text: oh! and when building, and i select a whole combined structure, can u let me save it as a prefab. please :D
resolution: Added save-as-prefab to the iso build pane. When a selection is active, a new ⊞ button (beside clone/delete) turns it into a reusable prefab: GAME_BUILD.placed.prefabFromPieces builds an origin-relative BuildPrefabDef preserving each piece's per-face skin and wall edit, and a prefabDefined WorldEvent registers it on the same worldStream the cart already merges into the prefabs rail (buildingPrefabs, index.tsx) — so it shows up in the PREFABS tab immediately, ready to stamp again (and it flat-pads onto terrain like any prefab). Auto-named 'Custom N' since the pane has no inline text input; theme is taken from the selection's first piece. Works for any selection — single piece, hand-built structure, or whole building. Committed bf626e050, bundles clean.
